Summary: Phone number link uses an invalid protocol format, making it unclickable on mobile
Description:
1. Navigate to Return Policy page on a mobile device or responsive view.
2. Scroll down to the contact section.
3. Click on the listed phone number link.
Observe: The link does not initiate a phone call because the href format is incorrect or missing the 'tel:' protocol prefix.
Expected Result: The phone number link should have a valid 'tel:+123456789' attribute and trigger the native dialer application when clicked on mobile.
Actual Result: Phone number link uses an invalid 'tel:' protocol href format, making it unclickable on mobile devices.

Summary: Checkout order total discrepancy due to omitted delivery tax calculation
Description:
1. Add items to the cart.
2. Proceed from cart screen to checkout screen.
3. Verify the breakdown of item total, delivery fee, taxes, and final payable amount.
Observe: The final total payable amount on the checkout screen ($120.50) is less than the actual cart summary total ($125.00) because the delivery tax component was left out of the final summation.
Expected Result: The final checkout order total must exactly match the cart total and include all applicable taxes, fees, and discounts.
Actual Result: Discrepancy found: Order total on checkout screen is $120.50 while cart total was $125.00 due to omitted delivery tax calculation.

Summary: Cart items are cleared and reset to zero after a hard browser page refresh (F5)
Description:
1. Add any 3 products to the shopping cart.
2. Observe the cart counter showing '3' items.
3. Perform a hard browser refresh (press F5 or Ctrl+R).
Observe: After the page reloads, the cart is completely empty and resets to zero items.
Expected Result: Cart items must persist across page refreshes using LocalStorage or SessionState persistence mechanisms.
Actual Result: Cart items are completely cleared and reset to zero after a hard browser refresh (F5).

Summary: Search queries with special characters (e.g., '%', '&') trigger a 500 Internal Server Error
Description:
1. Navigate to the product catalog page.
2. In the global search box, enter a special character such as '%' or '&' and press Enter.
Observe: Instead of displaying a graceful 'No items found matching your search' message, the application crashes and renders a 500 Internal Server Error page.
Expected Result: The system should properly sanitize and escape special characters in search fields, returning a zero-results view without breaking the application.
Actual Result: System encounters a 500 Internal Server Error page when searching with special characters like '%' or '&'.

Summary: Banner carousel navigation next/prev arrows are unresponsive on touch-screen devices
Description:
1. Access the homepage on a tablet or mobile screen view.
2. Attempt to tap on the left or right arrows of the main hero banner carousel.
Observe: The banner does not shift to the next or previous item; the control buttons are completely unresponsive to touch inputs.
Expected Result: The hero banner carousel arrows should support click and touch tap interactions to slide back and forth seamlessly.
Actual Result: Carousel next/prev arrows are completely unresponsive on touch-screen devices and iOS Safari.
Environment: QA Staging - Touch UI & iOS Safari

Summary: Password characters briefly visible in plain text during masking
Description:
1. Navigate to Login URL.
2. Enter text in the password field.
Observe: The characters remain visible as plain text for a split second before transforming into dots/asterisks, exposing sensitive data to shoulder surfing.
Expected Result: Password field input must be masked immediately upon entry without displaying plain text.
Actual Result: Password characters are briefly visible in plain text before masking.

Summary: Signup form accepts invalid mobile number format without validation error
Description:
1. Open Signup page.
2. Input an invalid or arbitrary length mobile number (e.g., '1234abc').
3. Click Submit.
Expected Result: The system should trigger a validation error 'Invalid mobile number format' and block form submission.
Actual Result: Mobile number accepted without any validation error, and the request was allowed and submitted to the backend.
